'''Miera Lij''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] who worked for the Security Forces of the [[Alvorine Authority]] during the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="THH" />

She had an addiction to [[Ryll/Legends|Ryll]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]].<ref name="THH" />
